title: SSC CPO SI PET/PST Admit Card 2026
postName: Sub-Inspector in Delhi Police and CAPFs – PET/PST
vacancyDetails: Physical Endurance Test and Physical Standard Test for CPO SI candidates qualified in Paper-I
qualification: Bachelor’s Degree from a recognized University
ageLimit: 20 to 25 years (as per CPO notification; relaxations apply)
selectionProcess: Paper-I → PET/PST → Paper-II → Medical → Final Result
documentsRequired: SSC login credentials; PET/PST admit card printout; sports kit; photo ID
howToApply:
1. Visit https://ssc.gov.in
2. Login with Registration Number and Password/DOB
3. Download CPO SI PET/PST Admit Card
4. Note venue and date between 21–28 July 2026
5. Report for physical tests as instructed
shortDescription: SSC CPO SI PET/PST Admit Card 2026 released on 13 July for physical tests from 21 to 28 July 2026. Download from ssc.gov.in.
content:
Staff Selection Commission has released the PET/PST Admit Card for Sub-Inspector in Delhi Police and CAPFs (CPO) on 13 July 2026.

Physical Endurance Test (PET) and Physical Standard Test (PST) are scheduled from 21 July to 28 July 2026 for Paper-I qualified candidates.

  • Download hall ticket from ssc.gov.in
  • Carry printed admit card and original photo ID
  • Meet height/chest/running standards as per notice
